question: A garden tap fills a rain tank at 72 litres per hour when fully open. Dan turned the tap so that it delivered exactly half that flow, and he ran it at that rate for 7 hours every day for 5 days into the empty tank. He then used half of the water in the tank on the lawn. A crack in the tank later leaked 552 litres. How many litres of water are left in the tank?

In the morning the delivery van set off with 105 litres of fuel in its tank. The long morning run to the coast used 64 litres, and the driver burned 2 litres idling in a queue at the ferry. In the afternoon the return trip used 28 litres. In the evening a short trip to the depot used 5 litres. How many litres of fuel are left in the tank?

In the morning Hiro had 103 lemons on his stall and gave 58 of them to the school kitchen, leaving him with more than Ines had on her stall. In the afternoon Hiro sold every lemon he had left at 8 cents each and put the money in his tin, and one customer added a 21-cent tip to the tin. In the evening he sold a jug of lemonade for 61 cents and put that in the tin too. How many cents are in Hiro's tin now?

In the morning a builder's merchant delivered 6 pallets of bricks, with 98 bricks on each pallet, and the site manager split them equally among his 3 building sites. Later in the morning the Mill Lane site received its share. In the afternoon 69 spare bricks from a demolition were added to the Mill Lane pile. In the evening the manager placed an order for the same number of bricks as the Mill Lane pile now held, to arrive on each of the next 8 working days, for each of his 2 new sites. How many bricks did the manager order?

On Saturday morning Lars's bakery had 214 bread rolls ready and baked 68 more. Mina's bakery, which has 12 ovens, had 7 times as many rolls as Lars did that morning, so Mina's was the busier shop. In the afternoon Mina sold 844 rolls and gave 63 rolls to a shelter. In the evening she sold every roll she had left at 5 cents each. How many cents did Mina take in the evening?

In the morning Nell checked the first seed tray in her nursery: it had been sown with 71 seeds but 54 of them had failed to sprout. Each of her shelves holds 3 trays like that one, every tray with the same number of sprouted seedlings, and each greenhouse has 7 shelves. Each tray is 40 centimetres wide. In the afternoon she confirmed that all 7 of her greenhouses matched the first one. In the evening she reported that all 5 farms in the cooperative had grown exactly the same as hers, a dozen years after the cooperative was founded. How many seedlings sprouted across the cooperative?

Pim earns 44 dollars a day at the cafe plus 17 dollars a day in tips, and he worked 8 days this fortnight. His manager gave him a 46-dollar bonus for covering a dozen extra shifts over the year. He then paid 467 dollars in rent. How many dollars does Pim have left from this fortnight's earnings?

In the morning Quinn brought 6 crates of eggs to the market, each holding 170 eggs, and sold 817 eggs before lunch to a restaurant that paid her separately. In the afternoon she sold every remaining egg to her dozen regulars at 8 cents each, and one of them added a 14-cent tip. The market is 12 kilometres from her farm. In the evening she worked out that her afternoon takings had been exactly the same on each of the 3 market days that week. How many cents did Quinn take in over those 3 afternoons in total?

On Monday morning Rae made 88 cents selling lemonade, and her brother Sol made twice as much as Rae at his own stand, so Sol was ahead. On Monday afternoon Sol made another 59 cents. Sol made exactly the same amount as he had on Monday on each of the 4 days from Monday to Thursday. On Thursday evening he spent 333 cents on a comic. Sol keeps his money in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents does Sol have left?

In the morning a greengrocer received 4 boxes of apples with 131 apples in each box, and he threw away 31 apples that were bruised. In the afternoon a farmer dropped off 37 more apples, and a neighbour brought 9 apples from her garden. In the evening the greengrocer sold 521 apples to a cider maker. How many apples does he have left?

Wes, who is 9 years old, was allowed 123 minutes of screen time on each school day. His parents cut that by 63 minutes and then by another 11 minutes a day. There are 5 school days in a week, and at the weekend he gets a bonus of 72 minutes on top of his school-day total. His parents kept this weekly plan for 5 weeks, which felt like a dozen years to Wes. How many minutes of screen time did Wes get over those 5 weeks?

Xu's cafe sells 75 cups of coffee each morning and twice that many cups over the whole day. On top of the coffees, the cafe sells 29 pots of tea each day. Xu's cafe is open 7 days a week, and the festival season lasts 3 weeks with the same sales every day. How many drinks does the cafe sell during the festival season?

In the morning a bakery put 46 cupcakes in its window and sold half of them before noon. In the afternoon the baker made 23 more cupcakes and put them in the window, and then sold 7 cupcakes to a passing family. In the evening 5 cupcakes were given to the staff. How many cupcakes are left in the window?

Bo's route around the park is 152 steps long, and every morning he walks it 3 times. He did that on each of the 7 mornings last week, and on the last morning he also walked 30 extra steps to the shop for milk. His neighbour Cy, who is recovering from a knee operation, walked exactly half as many steps as Bo did over the whole week, so Bo was well ahead of Cy. How many steps did Cy walk last week?

Dee's doctor told her to drink 9 glasses of water a day, and each of her glasses holds 240 millilitres. She also drinks 36 millilitres of water with her morning vitamins and 26 millilitres when she takes her evening tablet. That daily total is more than her flatmate Eli drinks in a day, and Eli owns a dozen water bottles. Dee kept exactly to this routine for all 7 days of last week. How many millilitres of water did Dee drink last week?

Gus started a round of the arcade game with 114 points. He lost 79 points in the first level, 22 points in the second, and 5 points in the third. The game has 20 levels in total. In the bonus level every point Gus still had became worth 6 points, and then a treasure chest added 30 points. How many points did Gus have at the end of the round?

Ida's team collected 215 cans for the recycling drive, and the other 2 teams collected exactly the same amount, so 3 teams' worth of cans went into the pile, triple what Ida's team alone had gathered. The pile was then shared equally among the 3 schools taking part, and Ida's school took its share. Her school divided its cans equally among its 5 classes, and Ida's class received its share. Ida's class then gave 6 cans to the art room, sent 29 cans to the recycling plant, and found 9 more cans behind the bike shed. How many cans does Ida's class have now?

On Saturday morning Jan had 84 dollars in her purse and spent half of it on a concert ticket. In the afternoon her aunt topped up Jan's purse until it held 3 times as much as it had after buying the ticket, and then Jan found 6 dollars in an old coat pocket and was given 6 dollars by her brother. The concert venue is 40 kilometres away. In the evening Jan spent half of everything in her purse on dinner. How many dollars are in Jan's purse now?

On Saturday morning Kay's bakery baked 4 trays of rolls with 188 rolls on each tray, and then 10 more rolls in a small tin. In the afternoon, Lou's much larger bakery on the same street had 7 times as many rolls as Kay's had that morning, and Lou then baked 23 more, so Lou had far more rolls than Kay. In the evening Lou sold 2123 rolls to a hotel, which serves a dozen kinds of bread at breakfast. How many rolls does Lou have left?

Mo had 86 dollars in her savings account. She deposited 11 dollars from her paper round, then withdrew 73 dollars for a new coat, and later deposited 10 dollars from a birthday card. The bank's young saver bonus then made her balance 3 times what it had been. She deposited 17 dollars from babysitting and 6 dollars from returning bottles. How many dollars are in Mo's account now?

A gardener planted 135 tulip bulbs, sharing them equally among 5 flower beds. In the front bed every bulb produced 9 flowers over the spring. The gardener also added 18 daffodils and 41 hyacinths to the front bed, which lies beside a dozen apple trees. She then cut 204 flowers from the front bed for bouquets. How many flowers are left in the front bed?

In the morning Pia's phone showed 227 minutes of talk time left on her plan. She made a 34-minute call to her mother and a 44-minute call to a client before lunch. In the afternoon she spent 52 minutes on a call with her landlord and 74 minutes on a call with her sister, who has a dozen cats. In the evening she made a 7-minute call to order a pizza. The plan shows the balance in minutes rather than hours, and sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of talk time does Pia have left?

Quin the plumber charges 70 dollars to visit a house plus 66 dollars for the first hour of work, and every one of the 6 jobs he did this week took exactly one hour. His van is 5 years old, and he has been a plumber for a dozen years. One customer gave him a 40-dollar tip. At the end of the week he spent 770 dollars on new tools. How many dollars does Quin have left from this week's work?

The Lyric theatre has 171 seats, but 27 of them are blocked off for the lighting rig during the festival. The theatre runs 6 shows a day, and on top of the seats it sells 21 standing tickets each day. A ticket costs 30 dollars. The festival lasts 5 days, and every seat and standing ticket was sold for every show, which pleased the theatre's dozen volunteers. How many tickets were sold during the festival?

Rex dug up 235 kilograms of potatoes from his main plot and 8 kilograms from the corner plot. Sal's farm, which covers 40 hectares, produced 6 times as many kilograms as Rex did in that harvest, so Sal's crop dwarfed Rex's. Sal also picked up 65 kilograms that the harvester had missed. Sal brought in 6 harvests like that over the season, and half of everything she harvested went to a wholesaler. How many kilograms did the wholesaler take?
